name: fastpostgres
abstract: PostgreSQL query results through POSIX shared memory, as typed arrays
description: A background worker runs each read with a portal and publishes every batch in /dev/shm: the result tuples as the executor laid them out (FPROWS) or a columnar frame (FPCOLUMN). The Python client maps the segment and reads it in place; writes, DDL and transactions keep using libpq.
